messages:
sophie: quick flag — EU-edge p2 observed a short but sharp latency tail this morning, looks like one tenant saturating GPU/egress for short bursts. filing a lightweight experiment proposal.
raul: who is the tenant? any traces yet?
sophie: t-942 (T-neo). we see repeated tiny requests causing KV-cache churn + PCIe stalls. p95 latency for short-gen increased from 120ms -> 520ms for other tenants sharing the slice.
jiang: is it more egress bandwidth or kernel hogging? NVLink metrics?
sophie: NVLink utilization spikes but PCIe write stall counters are the clearer signal. egress bytes/sec also spikes but for very short windows (<30s). not sustained.
nora: sounds like noisy neighbor but very bursty. full dedicated carveout too heavy-handed and costly. what's the experiment idea?
sophie: propose "solo-tenant granular throttle": create a per-tenant micro-token-bucket for egress+small-op GPU kernel launches plus a kvcache shielding rule. not a dedicated pool — isolated bandwidth caps with a short burst allowance. rollout as canary to one rack.
raul: how does shielding interact with kvcache regen? that regen kills perf for collocated tenants.
sophie: plan is: when tenant triggers regen threshold (regen-rate > X), temporarily apply a soft cap to their burst tokens and bump others' kvcache priority. short TTL (30s) then auto-decay. goal is to reduce spillover while preserving tenant's short bursts.
jiang: metrics to validate?
sophie: p50/p95 latency delta for co-tenants, PCIe stall counter, NVLink utilization, kvcache hit-rate, egress bytes/sec, and billing delta for the tenant (to watch cost impact).
raul: example config snippet for the token bucket?
sophie: ```
# per-tenant micro-throttle (example)
rules:
  - tenant: t-942
    scope: {egress: true, kernel_launch: true}
    token_bucket:
      rate: 50mbps
      burst: 10mb
      decay: 30s
    kvcache_shield:
      regen_threshold: 0.12 # regen/sec
      shield_duration: 30s
```
nora: nice. prefer starting lower on rate and observe. also add a metric alarm if we cause the tenant to hit throttling too often (SLO implications).
jiang: can we implement without changing agent runtime? maybe at proxy/routing layer + sidecar policing.
raul: sidecar policing + egress shaping at proxy looks easiest. avoids kernel patch. we can mark tenants with a temporary QoS tag.
ops-bot: scheduled: canary deploy of per-tenant micro-throttle on eu-edge-rack-7 at 2024-11-06T16:00Z by @raul. Rollback window 30m.
raul: I'll take the rollout. plan: 2-step canary — first monitor-only mode for 10m, then active throttle for 20m. telem dashboards will include tenant-level heatmap.
nora: add automated rollback if co-tenant p95 worsens by >10% or if the throttled tenant errors >2%.
sophie: agreed. also log a sampled trace for any throttle events (trace id -> use for postmortem if needed).
jiang: who owns dashboard and alert wiring?
raul: me for wiring, nora for SLO gating.
oncall: FYI — if this triggers any oncall noise, annotate the incidents channel and we'll treat as planned experiment.
nora: schedule a short post-canary sync in #eng-infra in 45m after rollout.
sophie: thanks — will post the runbook and links. TL;DR: soft per-tenant micro-throttle + kvcache shielding in eu-edge canary to reduce bursty noisy neighbor without full dedicated carveouts. :thumbsup:
raul: ack. will post status updates during rollout.
ops-bot: deploy started at 2024-11-06T16:00:00Z (canary mode)
sophie: monitoring shows regen rate dropped 80% for t-942 after shield applied. co-tenant p95 trending down.
nora: seeing small increase in throttled tenant's 95th (expected). still within SLO for now.
jiang: NVLink spike amplitude reduced, PCIe stall counters down 60% — promising.
raul: continuing for the 20m active window. will report final numbers.
ops-bot: deploy rollback triggered at 2024-11-06T16:45:00Z (manual) — reason: customer support flagged degraded responses for t-942. owner: raul.
sophie: pulled. quick postmortem: our initial rate too aggressive for T-neo's burst profile. mitigation: reduce base rate and increase burst allowance; add tenant-specific learning window to tune.
nora: action items: (1) raul tune config + re-run canary; (2) jiang add per-tenant learning probe to suggest rate/burst; (3) sophie write brief runbook + add trace sampling.
raul: assigning myself, will re-run with conservative defaults by EOD.
jiang: will instrument auto-suggest heuristics (per-tenant burst hist) in next patch.
ops-bot: follow-up reminder set: 2024-11-06T20:00:00Z -> canary re-run
sophie: thanks all. keeping this thread for notes and final numbers.
